meta.source: Curated community knowledge of stock Android, AOSP and Google apps.
meta.note: Risk levels are guidelines only. No removal is ever 100% safe. Always verify before removing a package.

android.reason: Core Android framework package. Removing it can brick the device.

com.android.systemui.reason: System UI — status bar, notifications and navigation. Required.

com.android.settings.reason: System Settings app. Required to configure the device.

com.android.phone.reason: Core telephony services. Removing breaks calls and mobile data.

com.android.server.telecom.reason: Telecom call handling. Required for calls.

com.android.providers.contacts.reason: Stores contacts. Required by dialer and messaging.

com.android.providers.media.reason: Media content provider used by nearly every app.

com.android.providers.calendar.reason: Calendar data provider. Only needed if you use the calendar.

com.android.shell.reason: ADB shell support. Required for adb itself.

com.android.vending.reason: Google Play Store. Removing it blocks app updates and many Google services.

com.android.permissioncontroller.reason: Handles runtime permissions. Required on modern Android.

com.android.bluetooth.reason: Bluetooth stack. Removing breaks Bluetooth entirely.

com.android.nfc.reason: NFC stack. Required for contactless payments.

com.android.location.fused.reason: Fused location provider. Many apps depend on it.

com.android.packageinstaller.reason: Installs APKs. Required for any sideloading.

com.android.documentsui.reason: Files picker used by many apps. Removing can break file sharing.

com.android.webview.reason: Web rendering engine. Many apps embed it. Required.

com.android.statementservice.reason: App link verification. Required on modern Android.

com.android.inputmethod.latin.reason: AOSP keyboard. Removing leaves you without a keyboard unless another is installed.

com.android.launcher3.reason: Default launcher. Only safe if a replacement launcher is installed.

com.android.dialer.reason: Phone dialer app. Removing breaks call UI.

com.android.contacts.reason: Contacts app UI. Replacement apps may exist.

com.android.mms.reason: Default SMS app. Replacement SMS apps exist.

com.android.cellbroadcastreceiver.reason: Receives emergency cell broadcast alerts (e.g. amber alerts).

com.android.printspooler.reason: Printing support. Only needed if you print from the phone.

com.android.captiveportallogin.reason: Wi-Fi login page for public networks.

com.android.egg.reason: Android easter egg. Harmless to remove.

com.android.traceur.reason: System bug-reports helper. Safe to remove.

com.android.camera2.reason: AOSP camera app. Removing disables the camera UI.

com.android.music.reason: AOSP music player. Generally safe to remove.

com.android.videoeditor.reason: AOSP video editor. Safe to remove.

com.android.email.reason: AOSP email client. Safe to remove.

com.android.browser.reason: AOSP web browser. Safe to remove.

com.android.chrome.reason: Google Chrome. Generally safe to remove; reinstallable from Play Store.

com.android.quicksearchbox.reason: AOSP search box. Safe to remove.

com.android.htmlviewer.reason: Simple HTML viewer. Safe to remove.

com.android.wallpaper.livepicker.reason: Live wallpaper picker. Safe to remove.

com.android.phasebeam.reason: Beam live wallpaper. Safe to remove.

com.android.stk.reason: SIM toolkit used by carriers. Keep if your carrier uses it.

com.android.cts.*.reason: Compatibility test packages. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.gms.reason: Google Play Services. Core Google functionality; many apps break without it.

com.google.android.gsf.reason: Google Services Framework. Required for Google services.

com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.reason: Google app / search. Most OEMs make it replaceable, but some features depend on it.

com.google.android.apps.search.reason: Google app (newer name). Verify before removing.

com.google.android.as.reason: Android System Intelligence. Powers smart features; removal is generally reversible via reinstall.

com.google.android.setupwizard.reason: Google Setup Wizard. Required for device setup on many devices.

com.google.android.feedback.reason: Google feedback tool. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.tts.reason: Google text-to-speech. Needed for accessibility and voice features.

com.google.android.marvin.talkback.reason: Accessibility screen reader. Keep unless you don't need it.

com.google.android.ext.services.reason: Google extensions to system services. Required.

com.google.android.ext.shared.reason: Shared Google libraries. Required by many apps.

com.google.android.chrome.reason: Chrome browser. Safe to remove; reinstallable.

com.google.android.youtube.reason: YouTube app. Safe to remove; reinstallable.

com.google.android.apps.maps.reason: Google Maps. Safe to remove; reinstallable.

com.google.android.apps.photos.reason: Google Photos. Many users rely on backup; removable but keep if you use it.

com.google.android.apps.messaging.reason: Google Messages (default SMS on many devices).

com.google.android.apps.contacts.reason: Google Contacts. Replacement contacts apps exist.

com.google.android.apps.dialer.reason: Google Phone dialer. Core dialer on Pixel devices.

com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher.reason: Pixel launcher. Only safe if another launcher is installed.

com.google.android.apps.wellbeing.reason: Digital Wellbeing. Removing reduces tracking, but it powers some features.

com.google.android.apps.docs.editors.doc.reason: Google Docs editor. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.apps.docs.editors.she.reason: Google Sheets editor. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.apps.docs.editors.sli.reason: Google Slides editor. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.music.reason: Google Play Music (legacy). Safe to remove.

com.google.android.apps.books.reason: Google Play Books. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.keep.reason: Google Keep notes. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.apps.subscriptions.re.reason: Google Play Games. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.play.games.reason: Play Games app. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.play.games.client.reason: Play Games client. Safe to remove.

com.google.android.apps.walletnfcrel.reason: Wallet NFC. Removing breaks contactless payments.

com.google.android.apps.nbu.files.reason: Files app. Replacement file managers exist.

com.google.android.documentsui.reason: Files app. Removal may affect file sharing.

com.google.ar.core.reason: ARCore. Many AR apps depend on it.

com.google.android.apps.photodreamer.reason: Photo effects app. Safe to remove.

com.facebook.katana.reason: Facebook app. Generally safe to remove.

com.facebook.orca.reason: Facebook Messenger. Generally safe to remove.

com.facebook.system.reason: Facebook system app. Some services may depend on it.

com.facebook.appmanager.reason: Manages Facebook apps. Removing may affect other FB apps.

com.facebook.services.reason: Facebook services. Used by FB apps for notifications.

com.twitter.android.reason: X / Twitter. Generally safe to remove.

com.microsoft.office.officehubrow.reason: Microsoft Office Hub. Safe to remove.

com.android.cts.*.reason: Compatibility test packages. Generally safe to remove.

com.qualcomm.*.reason: Qualcomm chipset components. Required for hardware function.

com.qti.*.reason: Qualcomm chipset components. Required for hardware function.

com.google.android.gms.*.reason: Google Play Services component. Removing can break Google functionality.
